verifier_note: Retrieved all 58 warrant sources across the 10 recipes directly (WebFetch against doc.rust-lang.org/stable at pinned 1.98.1, docs.rs at the pinned crate versions rapier3d-f64 0.35.3 / parry3d-f64 0.30.2 / slotmap 1.1.1 / typed-arena 2.0.2 / bumpalo 3.20.3); read solver/src/lib.rs, solver/src/rapier_law.rs, solver/build.mjs and solver/Cargo.toml from si-rpg-engine at main via read-only gh api for every engine_note; and additionally ran all 29 embedded checks myself through this lane's own scripts/compile_oracle.py against the actual pinned rustc 1.98.1 (already installed and set up locally) rather than relying only on the operator's separate run -- 29/29 passed with exact stdout, error-code, lint and wasm_call matches, including the wasm32 alignment probe (800) and every 'measured' byte-size claim (repr(Rust) reorder=8, Option<RigidBodyHandle>=12, Option<DefaultKey>=8, Plain=8/Tagged=16). Every source supported its claim as stated and every engine_note fact matched the live repository precisely, several down to exact line-level code (the ContactPair ptr::from_ref/&mut* cast, build_world's collider-then-heightfield-then-body insertion order, build.mjs's bodies_ptr()/8+i*17+slot indexing, snapshot_ptr/len read-then-copy ordering). The one systemic weakness: 2 of 10 recipes (mutate-through-unsafecell, re-read-a-vec-pointer) each have one check whose own label claims code 'compiles silently' / 'with no diagnostic at all', but neither check sets the schema's `no_warnings` field, so compile_oracle's pass/fail gate only verifies returncode 0, not silence -- a future stray lint would still show PASS. I independently compiled both and confirmed stderr is genuinely empty today (claims hold), but the checks as written don't enforce their own strongest claim; no recipe in this lane uses `no_warnings` at all despite the field existing for exactly this purpose.
